**Management Summary – Project LV 160,242 €**

The tender suffers from pervasive specification gaps that inflate risk and impede accurate cost estimating. Key medium‑severity omissions (total ≈ 13,500 €) include undefined site‑establishment scope, missing technical data for paving, asphalt layers, mortar class, shaft concrete, frost‑protection, insulation, plaster, and water‑impact class. These gaps prevent reliable unit‑price calculations, may trigger change orders, and jeopardize compliance with STLB‑Bau, DIN, and GEG standards. Low‑severity issues (≈ 850 €) relate to missing foundation details for shafts and exposure class for HD‑PE pipes. Immediate actions: (1) request detailed specifications for all listed items; (2) revise the bill of quantities with complete material, thickness, and performance criteria; (3) reassess the budget to incorporate contingency for potential redesigns and compliance checks. This will safeguard schedule, cost control, and regulatory approval.
